Tosafot on Bava Batra 86b:2:1.hebrew: אטו פשתן בשליפי רברבי מי לא עבדי ליה - בשלמא אי מוקמינן רישא בשליפי זוטרי, וכן פשתן בשליפי זוטרי, ובעינן ביה בהגבהה — משום שאין דרכו במשיכה כלל; אבל שאר דברים, אע"פ שדרכן בהגבהה, נקנית נמי במשיכה. אבל השתא דמוקמינן בשליפי רברבי, אמאי פשתן אינו נקנה אלא עד שיטלטלנו, דהיינו בהגבהה? והא אורחיה במשיכה, כיון שהוא בשליפי רברבי:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 86b:2:1.english: "Is it that they do not do this [pulling] with flax in large bundles?" - It would be well if we established the first clause as referring to small bundles, and likewise flax as [sold] in small bundles, and we require [acquisition] by lifting in its case — because it is not the way [of such flax] to be moved by pulling at all; but other items, even though their way is by lifting, are also acquired through pulling. But now that we establish [the case] as one of large bundles, why is flax not acquired until one moves it, meaning by lifting? Isn't its way [to be moved] by pulling, since it is in large bundles?

Tosafot on Bava Batra 86b:4:1.hebrew: ראשון ראשון קנה - פ"ה: דלא מצי למיפרך מסיפא דקתני "ברשות לוקח", כיון שקיבל עליו מוכר — קנה, דאיכא לאוקומי כשנתמלאה המדה. ואין נראה לר"י, דלא מצי למימר דאיירי כשנתמלאה המדה, דא"כ ליתני בהדי' בבא דסרסור, ולתני "ברה"ר ובחצר שאינו של שניהן וברשות לוקח" כו'. ומיהו לא ניחא ליה למיפרך מסיפא, כיון דמצי פריך מרישא:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 86b:4:1.english: "Each one, each one, he acquires" - Rashi explains: [The Gemara] cannot raise a difficulty from the latter clause, which states "in the buyer's domain," since once the seller has accepted [responsibility] upon himself, [the buyer] has acquired [the produce], for it is possible to establish [that latter clause as referring to a case] where the measure was filled. But this does not seem [correct] to Rabbeinu Yitzchak, for one cannot say that [the Mishnah] is speaking of a case where the measure was filled, for if so, let it teach, together with it, the clause about the broker, and let it teach: "in the public domain, and in a courtyard that does not belong to both of them, and in the buyer's domain," etc. However, [the Gemara] was not inclined to raise a difficulty from the latter clause, since it can raise one from the first clause.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 86b:6:1.hebrew: כדאמר רב כהנא שנתות היו בהין - תימה לרבינו חיים: והלא לא רב כהנא אמרה, אלא משנה היא בפ' ב' מדות (מנחות דף פז:)! ואר"י דבפ' המוציא יין (שבת דף עח:) תנן: סיד כדי לעשות אנדיפי, ומפרש רב כהנא (שם פ:): מאי אנדיפי? שנתות, כדתנן: שנתות היו בהין כו'. הלכך מביא הכא רב כהנא דאשמעי' דאפילו במדות של חול עושין, ולכך מיחייב המוציא סיד כשיעור לעשות בו שנתות; אבל ממתניתין דמנחות לא חזינן שיש שנתות אלא במדות של קודש:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 86b:6:1.english: As Rav Kahana said: There were notches in the hin - Rabbeinu Chaim wonders: But Rav Kahana did not say this; rather, it is a Mishnah, in the chapter "Shtei Middot" (Menachot 87b)! And Rabbi Yitzchak said: In the chapter "HaMotzi Yayin" (Shabbat 78b) we learned: [One who carries out] plaster [is liable for] enough to make an andifi, and Rav Kahana explains (there, 80b): What is an andifi? Notches, as we learned: "There were notches in the hin," etc. Therefore [the Gemara] cites Rav Kahana here, to teach us that even in non-sacred measures they make [notches], and for this reason one who carries out plaster is liable for the amount needed to make notches with it; but from the Mishnah in Menachot we only see that there are notches in sacred measures.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 86b:7:1.hebrew: דינר ליום כו' - נראה לרשב"א דהא דתנן באיזהו נשך (ב"מ דף סה.): "מרבין על השכר, ואין מרבין על המכר" — האי דשרי להרבות על השכר, כגון שנכנס מיד לתוך הבית; דבענין אחר לא שרי להרבות, דמיחזי כאגר נטר, כדאמרינן הכא:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 86b:7:1.english: "A dinar per day," etc. - It appears to the Rashba that [with regard to] that which we learned in [the chapter] "Eizehu Neshekh" (Bava Metzia 65a): "One may increase [the payment] for a rental, but one may not increase [the price] for a sale" — that it is permitted to increase [the payment] for a rental, [this applies] where [the renter] enters immediately into the house; for in another circumstance it is not permitted to increase, because it appears as payment for waiting (agar natar), as we say here.
